issues.description: The problem statement specifies a Course with a var called `ratings` (implying a publicly visible property), and the template declares `var ratings: [Int]` in Sources/DeveloperLib/Course.swift, but the solution makes the property `private var ratings: [Int]`. This visibility difference (template/problem implying an accessible property vs. solution hiding it) can confuse students about whether `ratings` should be externally accessible or encapsulated.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the intended visibility explicit and consistent across artifacts. Either (a) update the template (and problem text) to declare `private var ratings: [Int]` so the field is encapsulated as in the solution, or (b) change the solution to use a non-private `ratings` and document that it's intentionally accessible. Prefer making the template match the solution by marking `ratings` private and adding a short comment explaining encapsulation so students understand the design choice.
